We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied first two templates successfully, got precursors. Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to generate a chain of 5 steps ending in simple buyable precursors maybe.

We need to construct JSON route: root molecule (target) with children reaction using template 29646 leading to precursors (maybe multiple). Then each precursor further broken down using next template etc. The order must be as given.

We need to ensure each step matches the template to the molecule we are applying to. We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three SMILES). We need to choose one that can be further processed by template 1914389. The apply_template result gave three precursors: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
2) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'
3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'

We applied template 1914389 to the first precursor and got two products: 
('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC')

So template 1914389 transforms that precursor into two fragments (maybe a disconnection). We need to continue with template 1914390 on each fragment? The order says after 1914389, apply 1914390. Likely to each resulting fragment sequentially? Probably we need a linear chain: each step takes a single molecule and splits into precursors. So we need to pick one of the fragments from previous step to apply next template. Which fragment matches 1914390? We tried both and got false. Maybe we need to apply 1914390 to the other fragment (the second one) but also false. Maybe we need to apply to a different precursor from first step (choose second or third). Let's test.
